entries.title: Goal
entries.summary: Start the full development environment with PostgreSQL, FastAPI backend, and React frontend.

entries.title: Prerequisites
entries.summary: - Node.js >= 18 - Python >= 3.10 - Docker (for PostgreSQL) - Install backend deps: `pip install -r backend/requirements.txt` - Install frontend deps: `cd frontend && npm install`

entries.title: Steps
entries.summary: 1. Start PostgreSQL: `docker compose up -d postgres` 2. Start FastAPI backend: `cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000` 3. Start Vite frontend: `cd frontend && npm run dev` (serves on port 5173, proxies `/api` to `localhost

entries.title: Expected Outcome
entries.summary: - Backend API reachable at http://localhost:8000 - Frontend reachable at http://localhost:5173 with HMR active - API requests from frontend proxied to backend automatically

entries.title: Common Pitfalls
entries.summary: - PostgreSQL not ready: wait for health check, then start backend - Port conflicts: check if port 8000 or 5173 is already in use - Missing env vars: copy `backend/.env.example` to `backend/.env` and configure
